36th-Floor 2 Bed + Den | Skyline & Water Views | Capitol Residences | $4,500

Bright 36th-floor home at Capitol Residences, at Seymour and Robson, with unobstructed south-facing city skyline and water views from the living room, den and both bedrooms.

THE UNIT

• Approx. 1,174 sq ft with 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms and an open den—ideal for a home office
• Walk-in closets in both bedrooms
• In-unit walk-in storage room with shelving
• Long balcony spanning the living room and bedrooms; natural gas, propane and electric BBQs permitted
• Renovated in 2024 with engineered hardwood and acoustic underlay throughout, plus a full repaint of walls, ceilings, trim and cabinets
• Kitchen with gas cooktop and granite counters
• Air conditioning
• New in-suite washer and dryer
• One secure underground parking stall on P2 included

THE BUILDING & LOCATION

• Concierge, gym, lounge and meeting room
• Steps from Robson Street, the Orpheum, Vancouver Art Gallery and Pacific Centre, with easy access to Granville SkyTrain and Yaletown

TERMS

• $4,850/month, including parking
• Gas and hot water included; tenant pays BC Hydro, including electric baseboard heat, and internet
• Unfurnished; furniture and décor shown in photos are not included
• Available December 1, 2026; November 15 may be possible by agreement
• One-year fixed-term tenancy, then month-to-month
• Security deposit: $2,250
• Pets considered with landlord approval, within strata limits: one dog, two cats, or one dog and one cat
• Pet damage deposit required for approved pets, up to $2,250 total
• One-time strata move-in fee: $250, paid by the tenant
• No smoking or vaping anywhere in the building, including inside the unit or on the balcony
• No short-term rentals or Airbnb
• Subletting or assignment requires prior written landlord consent, subject to B.C. tenancy law
• Tenant insurance required
